 Parents urged to stop using nearly 20,000 nursing pillows sold on Amazon
 "They can obstruct an infant's breathing, posing a serious risk of injury or death from suffocation."
 by Aaron Goldstein November 15, 2026 
 share
 Facebook 
 Twitter 
 Link Copied! 
 Photo Credit: iStock 
 Parents are being urged to stop using nearly 20,000 recalled nursing pillows after the U.S. Consumer Product Safety Commission identified them as potentially deadly hazards. 
 Here's what to know
 The recall , announced by the CPSC, includes 19,596 X-VESOLJE nursing pillows sold by the Kikea Store.
 As the agency explained in the recall notice , "The recalled nursing pillows violate the mandatory safety standards for nursing pillows because they can obstruct an infant's breathing, posing a serious risk of injury or death from suffocation."
 #Recall: Kikea Store Recalls X-VESOLJE Nursing Pillows; The recalled nursing pillows violate the mandatory safety standards for nursing pillows because they can obstruct an infant's breathing. Get refund. https://t.co/BId1716DHc https://t.co/7av6kjhYe1
— US Consumer Product Safety Commission (@USCPSC) November 5, 2026 
 Thankfully, as of the time of the recall notice, there had been no injuries or incidents reported due to the hazard. The pillows were sold on Amazon between April 2025 and June 2026 and cost between $24 and $34.
 Because the pillows don't include labels or markings to identify them, customers are being urged to compare them against their descriptions in the recall . The pillows are C-shaped and can be found "in white with leaves pattern, dark brown with multi-colored feather pattern, and multi-colored puzzle piece pattern." 
 The model number of the recalled nursing pillows is NP001, and the recall number is 27-071.

 What can be done?
 The CPSC is urging parents to stop using the recalled pillows immediately. For those seeking reimbursement for the recalled products, consumers can contact the Kikea Store to get a refund. 
 To secure the refund, pillow owners must first confirm with the store that they purchased the affected product, then cut it in half and send an image of the destroyed item to zsally929@gmail.com. 
 Where can I learn more?
 High chairs, toys, and gripe water have also been recalled. 
 • Parents were urged to stop using recalled high chairs and toys sold through Walmart, Target, and Amazon.
 • Baby's Magic Tea gripe water sold on Amazon was recalled over three alcohols , including methanol.
 • The CPSC warns families to never microwave squishy toys , as counterfeit units are being blocked at U.S. ports.
